showOverlay (memory_admin.html:1157-1177) only needs #rowModal and #modalBody, which are static markup (lines 327, 333) and bound at 739-740, so they can't be missing. It does no network or permission calls. It clears modalBody, appends a readonly textarea, and adds the 'on' class. rowModal is the only modal that shows content; it is reused rather than hidden by another one, so an already-open row modal is overwritten by the overlay. Possible clobbering by a late openRow response (line 786) would need the user to click Export while the modal is open, and the aria-modal backdrop blocks that. So the comment's 'always works' holds for every reachable widget state. offerDownload (1084-1138) reaches showOverlay as the last fallback after the download, clipboard and execCommand attempts fail.
